ops.body: - Nov 18 (fix drive-card-return, scrapped after six instrumented runs on the `/chronicles` build; its debug steps saved, not shipped): the far step (DW14) fails at once after `pg.goto(exploreUrl)` from 11.5 km east, and passes when the journey waits 8 s before `openCard`. The Towns row shows Providence selected, yet the first tap on Cranston enters its page as if Cranston were the screen's selection; on the page the neighborhood's card is selected, not the town's own, against EC12 ("opening a page selects the first card"), so the tap on the town's card only selects it and a second tap opens it. The row was not scrolling (scrollLeft 316 throughout). Where the screen's selection and the row's shown one part is not found; the next step is to log `selected` beside `firstSelection` on Explore's mount after a far `goto`.

argv: a duplicate of the Navigation and routes entry that already records drive's DW3 timeout; the evidence is noted there (Nov 18)
